statements.statement: The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to evaluate for a potential arrhythmic etiology contributing to these symptoms
The denial reason code is CO-50
The diagnosis codes are I25.10, I34.0, R42
